correctness.rationale: Proof verified for all positive n,w,h,t. Finite poset rank levels are automorphism-invariant antichains; each maximal prime power assigned to a witnessing cycle costs no more than that cycle length, establishing the per-level packing and point budget. Ordinal sums of antichain levels with disjoint prime-power cycles attain all feasible budgets and exact period. The least width temporal exponent follows via finite antichain cycles and unrestricted one-atom valuations. Independent standard-library scripts checked 242 labelled posets/419 automorphisms, 286 constructive witnesses and 32 independent permutation spectra; computations corroborate and do not replace proof.

value.rationale: A natural complete three-resource existence classification for the finite reversible models motivated by recent dynamic topological logic; it determines exact minimal height from prime-power bin packing and sharp modal temporal exponents. The strict 11-to-12 width tradeoff for order 27720 with 40 worlds demonstrates that height is an independent structural resource. The theorem is neither a lone small enumeration nor a mere renaming of classical Landau bounds; it supplies the full parameterized feasibility frontier.
